caption: The video showcases a small silver ball moving leftward along an orange toy track taped to white louvered closet doors. Orange tape and a black clip hold the track near the right side of the frame, while the ball stays near the center as the camera pans. The ball moves slowly toward the curved left section, increasing its distance from the taped support as the doors move across the frame. The camera viewpoint shifts leftward, revealing another taped attachment point and the downward bend of the track. The silver ball remains on the track, passing near the tape as the baseboard and carpeted floor come into view on the left. Throughout, the motion is steady and the track stays attached to the doors, with the ball still moving leftward along the track.
